messages.subject: Label facet margins
parts:
Hi,

is there a way to label the margins (as in the margin variables) of a facet grid?

I have two variables with the same factor levels and I'd like to inform the reader which axis corresponds to which variable.

label_both is unreadable because variable names + levels are too long.

Basically all I'd need is a way to insert a second xlab and ylab on the other side of the plot. Is that possible?

Thanks a lot

Stefan
